doc.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript

title: Born in Bogalusa, raised in New Orleans, mother's music
summary: Born elsewhere, brought to New Orleans at two months, raised near Canal Street; his mother played many instruments and was his first teacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: It's funny, the first time I think I saw you was at Tulane, so that's very appropriate. Yeah, we have a little bit of Professor and all. Where'd you grow up, what part of town did you grow up in? Were you, you weren't born in New Orleans, were you?

I was born in Bugaloocy, but my mother brought me here when I was about two months old. And I was born around seven or eight blocks, not born, but I was raised about seven or eight blocks from Canal Street, on the south side. On the south side.
Uh, somebody told me that your mother played piano a lot.
My mother played guitar, drum, bass, piano, harmonica, juice, harp. She also danced and sung. So this is where all my teaching mostly really started from.
So you've been playing as long as you can remember?
As long as I can remember I've been banging and hitting.
